subject: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses

Team —

We need to close the QBR materials by EOD Wednesday so the exec deck is locked Thursday morning. Primary asks:

1) Consolidated forecast: reconcile ACME numbers across CRM, CS notes, and procurement expectations (attached export). I marked the current working total in the CSV but we need final sign-off.
2) Account synopses: 1-slide account summary for each named deal (risk, next step, runway, recommended ask). I attached my draft ACME synopsis (ACME_account_brief.pdf) — please edit.
3) Sales deck: assemble a slide in the deck that calls out any forecast deltas > $50k and recommended mitigation (discount, technical pilot, faster PO). See redwood_qbr_template_v2.pptx.

Ownership: Karthik — take point on ACME reconciliation and lead call with Susan if needed. Laura — incorporate the synopses into the deck and standardize slide format. Rishi — run the forecast consolidation and validate ARR math against the CSV.

Deadlines: first-pass updates by EOD Tuesday (Jan 19), final deck by 9am PT Thursday (Jan 21).

Attachments: ACME_account_brief.pdf (draft), QBR_data_export_20270118.csv (raw), redwood_qbr_template_v2.pptx

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses

Marissa —

Got it. Quick questions before I start the ACME reconciliation:

- The CSV shows a PO-in-flight value of $480k; procurement (last note) quoted $420k as the expected close amount. Do you want us to show the conservative $420k or the CRM $480k?
- Susan's commercial lead said they want a 30-day pilot option. If we bake a pilot into the ask, do we present it as a contingent add-on (not in ARR) or reduce the near-term ARR to reflect probability?

I'll take lead on the call with Susan tomorrow morning if that works — propose 9am PT. Also will flag any contract terms that require legal sign-off (SaaS data residency language they mentioned).

I'll update the draft ACME_account_brief and push to the shared Drive folder.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses

Looping in a format note — I can take the account synopsis template and standardize language (probability phrasing, key risks, recommended mitigations).

Plan: I'll create a master slide per deal and drop into the deck. If you add a 2-line 'critical ask' at the top of each brief, it'll make the exec slide deck cleaner.

Also suggest we call out a single mitigation per high-risk deal (discount, pilot, or executive intro).

Laura
Senior Sales Ops
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Susan Lee <susan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the draft summary. Quick updates from our side:

- Procurement is now expecting the PO to land at $435,000 (we had some line-item reductions).
- Our legal asks are limited to standard data processing language and a short-term SOC 2 attestation for the pilot — we can share a template SOC summary this afternoon.
- We would prefer the 30-day pilot to be scoped as a commercial pilot (not discounted full license) and run as a separate invoice; we expect to convert if KPIs are met.

We can do 9am PT tomorrow for the reconciliation call — that's fine. I'll have procurement and our technical lead on the call.

Best,
Susan Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme Corp
susan@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-4456

Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: finalize sales deck, consolidated forecast, and account synopses

Thanks all — quick recap and owners after today's call:

- Final ACME expected value: $435,000 (Procurement confirmed). Karthik — please set CRM to conservative close amount $435k and note 'pending PO' with expected ship date 2027-02-10.
- Pilot: Acme will run a 30-day commercial pilot invoiced separately. Rishi — mark pilot as non-ARR in the consolidated forecast and create a line item for potential upsell (probability 60%).
- Legal/SOC: Susan will share SOC summary; Karthik, please loop Legal on the attestation when you receive it.
- Deck: Laura will create the ACME one-slide synopsis and include the single mitigation (commercial pilot) and the ask (exec intro to product team if pilot KPIs met).

Action items & deadlines:
- Karthik: update CRM and share signed PO status by EOD Wednesday (Jan 20).
- Laura: drop finalized slide into the deck by 10am PT Wednesday (Jan 20).
- Rishi: update consolidated forecast and circulate an updated CSV by EOD Wednesday (Jan 20).
- Susan: send SOC summary and procurement confirmation (email) to the thread when available.

I'll merge ACME slide into the exec deck after I get Laura's slide. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
